fixes.why: At ≥900px the five stops are stretched grid items, so each stop's three rows spread out: the Persian label and note sit at different heights in every column (see index-desktop-3: Inquiry's درخواست floats 80px below its title while Proposal's hugs it).

fixes.what: Scope the pre-JS link strip to `html:not(.js) .site-nav` (the `js` class is set inline in <head>), and add `html.js:not(.nav-ready) .site-nav{display:none}`; keep `html:not(.js) .nav-toggle{visibility:hidden}`.
fixes.why: Today every phone page load paints a deep-night strip of three links under the bar, then collapses it when the deferred site.js (~130 KB of vendors first) runs: a visible flash on slow connections, worse than the no-JS fallback it protects.

fixes.where: index.html hero `` and the matching ``
fixes.what: Export `assets/tree/canopy-u3-2048.webp` and add `2048w` to both srcset lists (sizes unchanged).
fixes.why: On a 390px DPR-3 phone `175vw` resolves to 2047 device px, so the browser skips the 1376w file and preloads the full 2752w canopy (378 KB) before first paint; a 2048w file (~220 KB) halves the phone hero critical path.

fixes.what: Add `var onMQ=function(mq,fn){ if(mq.addEventListener){mq.addEventListener('change',fn);} else if(mq.addListener){mq.addListener(fn);} };` next to `rmq` and use it for all five calls.
fixes.why: Only `rmq` has the `addListener` fallback; on an old Safari the first call throws inside the header block before `nav-ready`, `panel-ready`, the accordion, the AJAX form and motion ever bind, leaving a half-dead page instead of the graceful no-JS fallback the CSS was designed for.

fixes.where: assets/img/pom-pile-1400.jpg (359 KB) and pom-pile.jpg (441 KB), used four times across index/weddings/about
fixes.what: Re-encode the pom-pile set at ~q72 with chroma subsampling (target ≤180 KB for 1400w) or re-run the same export used for pom-open-closeup (131 KB at 1400w).
fixes.why: Phones choose the 1400w file for every stacked celebration panel (100vw × DPR 3), so the pom-pile stand-in alone costs ~720 KB on index; keep the pipeline lean now so the real photos inherit sane sizes.
